_about: Known defective or doubtful tests of autogen_01 and autogen_02 (roadmap step 1, 2026-09-27; updated in step 3 the same day, and after the discussion of 6a on 2026-09-28). A scenario's entry covers every test derived from it. `for_new_agents` (the name is historical) is the action for every agent's results: by the decision 'flawed is flawed', a test to leave out is left out of all results, Qwen's recorded ones included, and counted as flawed in the generation numbers; when it was found is a footnote. 'Weak but valid' tests are kept. `frozen_suite` is what the frozen suite of roadmap step 6 does with the entry: keep, leave out, read before it runs, or dropped by the derivation. `near_misses` holds the PI's rulings on the near misses the manual validity reviews doubted, by their original ids (suite_opaque/ids/ maps them to the opaque ids): a flawed near miss takes out the probe and the policy units that hold it; a cover or fact probe that holds it stays, and a trial whose only acted-on records are flawed near misses does not count. A valid near miss may still leave out a named form (`leave_out`). `clocks` sets the instant the agent's clock starts at for every test of a scenario that is only right on some days. Since 2026-09-28 every test runs with opaque ids (autogen_01/kit/opaque_ids.py). This list is also the start of the failure-attribution development set (roadmap step 5).
